name: Trim Stain Prep — Template (EA_SIDE)
intent: Initial bare-wood stain prep for EA_SIDE substrates — int_door_slab (DSST). Uses the door-side keepers shared with paint-side prep (TSK_DOOR_SAND_PREP, TSK_DOOR_CLEAN_DUST) plus TSK_CONDITIONER_EA_SIDE on softwood. Door slab has no per-prep small-fill task — fastener holes / small fills are handled by TSK_WOOD_PUTTY_EA_SIDE in MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM_STAIN_EA_SIDE.
doctrine: EA_SIDE parallel to LF/SF stain prep templates. Currently only MOD_PREP_DSST_STAIN extends this. Door slab shares prep tasks with paint-side MOD_PREP_DOOR (same TSK_DOOR_* keepers); only the conditioner is stain-specific. Defects + fastener fills go in interstage.
